wiki.title: John Lively (politician)
wiki.extract: John Douglas Lively (born November 30, 1946) is an American politician and a Democratic member of the Oregon House of Representatives representing District 12 since January 14, 2013. Lively was the mayor of Springfield, Oregon, and a member of its city council from 1977 until 1986.
